content: For small self/cheap-hosted Spring Boot apps on Railway/Render/Fly.io in 2025/2026: Render offers free-tier PostgreSQL with no credit card required alongside free web services; Railway offers one-click Postgres provisioning but free credit only covers a few hours/month of runtime; Fly.io requires a credit card and no longer offers a free tier for new accounts. Managed Postgres (as a separate service) is the safer choice over file-based SQLite for apps requiring restart-durability, because free-tier app containers on these platforms typically have ephemeral filesystems (SQLite file would be lost on redeploy/restart) unless a paid persistent volume is attached.
